title: I don't like acrylic for apothecary
text: I don't like acrylic for apothecary. My bad for not reading the fine print.  Apothecary should be in glass jars I think.  I was disappointed that these are acrylic.  I will probably give as a gift.  Its nice that there are two sizes and I like the shape.
